# The two RSA public keys the official updater ships, base64 X.509, one per line.
#
# The first is the one that signs the live feeds beside this file; the second is
# here because the official client trusts it too, and a reader that accepts a feed
# under the wrong one of a trusted pair is a bug this suite has to be able to
# see. Read out of the official client, which is the only thing that can say what
# it trusts, not out of anything on our side.
